# Golden Maple

> Premium art brushes and supplies for miniature painting, watercolor, calligraphy, and fine detail work.

Golden Maple specializes in professional-grade brushes featuring Kolinsky Sable and synthetic hair options, serving miniature painters, watercolor artists, and calligraphy enthusiasts. The brand offers curated collections including the Masters Collection, designed for detailed artwork across multiple painting disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Kolinsky Sable
- Miniature Painting
- Detail Brushes
- Watercolor Brushes
- Fine Detail Work
- Synthetic Hair Brushes
- Natural Hair Brushes
- Chinese Calligraphy
- Acrylic & Oil Painting
- Brush Sets
- Paint Palettes
- Artist Supplies
- Warhammer 40K
- D&D Miniatures
- Professional Brush Collections

## Miniature Brushes

- [Professional Miniature Paint Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush): Golden Maple professional miniature paint brushes with Kolinsky Sable and synthetic options
- [Detail Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush-detail-brush): Golden Maple detail brush collection featuring Kolinsky Sable miniature paint brushes
- [Base Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush-base-brush): Golden Maple base brush collection for miniature painting fine detail work
- [Dry Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush-dry-brush): Golden Maple dry brush collection for miniature painting with Kolinsky Sable
- [Natural Hair Miniature Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush-natural-hair): Golden Maple natural hair Kolinsky Sable miniature brush collection
- [Synthetic Hair Miniature Brushes](https://artgoldenmaple.com/collections/miniature-brush-synthetic-hair): Golden Maple synthetic hair miniature brush collection for painting
